scanWindow: Since the 2026-09-04 completed scan, plus material missed developments from the previous 48 hours
notes: Completed the 2026-09-05 editorial scan. Published one Daily Brief on Google WeatherNext 3, a material development missed in the prior narrow scan window. Google DeepMind and Google Research say the model ingests live geostationary satellite mosaics, generates a fresh global forecast every hour, resolves key surface variables down to 5 kilometers and is being integrated into Search, Gemini, Maps, Maps Platform, Earth Engine and Cloud data products. Google reports up to 50% better precipitation accuracy for forecasts a day or more ahead; AI Compass treats that figure as vendor evidence and retains the explicit warning that official meteorological agencies remain authoritative for severe-weather alerts. Lyria 3.5 moving into Gemini and the Gemini API was scored Worth knowing but held because it is primarily a creative-model distribution expansion rather than a broader architectural or governance shift. Agentic video understanding was also scored Worth knowing but is a September 1 development that did not justify displacing the stronger WeatherNext item today. GPT-6 Astra follow-up coverage was deduplicated against existing Astra cyber-threshold coverage. NVIDIA local-AI IFA follow-up was deduplicated against the September 4 scan. Rumours, unsupported rankings and unverified pricing were excluded.
